notes.title: Patch 1.01 notes
notes.notes:
Hello,
A new patch is available.
Fixing some glitches:
- fixed stuck in water in some cases
- fixed disappearing houses
- fixed skipping intro scene
- fixed sounds on player death
- some zombie sounds have been changed for better
- fixed some legs collisions problems
